sloka: एकाक्षीमेककर्णां च कर्णप्रावरणां तथा ।गोकर्णीं हस्तिकर्णीं च लम्बकर्णीमकर्णिकाम् ।। ५.२०.३१।।।।
transliteration: ekākṣīmekakarṇāṁ ca karṇaprāvaraṇāṁ tathā ।gokarṇīṁ hastikarṇīṁ ca lambakarṇīmakarṇikām ।। 5.20.31।।।।

translations.english: "O Janaki There are a number of virtuous consorts residing in the harem of my royal palace. You may exercise your authority on all of them.
